title: so far so good, but going to give more time to determine final rating
text: so far so good, but going to give more time to determine final rating. Small, lightweight. Plugs into three prong outlet. It has turned on and heated, but I am being reserved on my review at this time as I want to give it a few weeks of on and off use to determine if it truly works and can be relied upon. Then I will come back to update and make final rating. The price keeps going up every time I look at this page. Got this at $79 a week or so ago, now is $110.
